summary: Listed in the tnlandforms.us Georgia lookout index as a Stewart County tower at 32.10932, -84.74437; no build, staffing or fate record found.

evidence.supports: index lists a Stewart Lookout Tower in Stewart County with its coordinates
the page is the Georgia lookout towers index

notes_for_editor: Story is about 40 words, far under the 120-word floor, because the only source is one index row (GA051). The index elevation column has no unit label, so no elevation is used in the story. Two web searches, the Stewart County history page (stewartcountyga.gov, no tower mentioned), the NHLR Georgia index (no Stewart entry) and the FFLOS Georgia listing (two entries, neither Stewart) gave no build, staffing, fire or fate record. A Crown Castle inventory lists a 'Stewart 1' tower in the county, but it is a telecom list and was not used. Keep separate from us-ga-black-creek (GA217) and the GA379 providence row, which are other index rows in the same county. Recommend holding from publication until a second source turns up.
